Chameleon.name: Chameleon
Chameleon.summary: Chameleon offers players simple controls that are easy to get into along with competitive play as you attempt to match colors on your playfield. The game features several playable characters along with a bonus character. A variety of different modes and rule sets bring great replay-ability to this addictive game.

Gundam Battle Royale.name: Gundam Battle Royale
Gundam Battle Royale.summary: Gundam Battle Royale is a game released for the PlayStation Portable. The game was released only in Japan and South Korea on October 5, 2006. The game features many mobile suits and mobile armors from the Universal Century up to and including Zeta Gundam. It is the sequel to Gundam Battle Tactics. A sequel called Gundam Battle Chronicles has been released on 25 October 2007.

Harukanaru Toki no Naka de 4 - Aizouban.name: Harukanaru Toki no Naka de 4
Harukanaru Toki no Naka de 4 - Aizouban.summary:
In Harukanaru Toki no Naka de 4, follows Chihiro Ashihara, one of two princesses of a kingdom locatrd in a land called Nakatsu Kuni within the parallel world. During her childhood, the kingdom was invaded by forces led by the king of Tokoyo no Kuni, a distant rival land connected to her kingdom. As Nakatsu Kuni is quickly overwhelmed, a divine power sends the protagonist through space-time to the modern world, protecting her from her kingdom's slaughter and ruin.

Five years have passed since the massacre and the protagonist has suppressed her memories of her true origins. She believes she has been raised in the modern world and enjoys her peaceful life as an average high school student. Yet a mysterious encounter she has after school soon forces her to remember her true past and birthright. Returning to her home world, the protagonist is determined to save her people and resurrect her dying kingdom.

Initial D - Street Stage.name: Initial D: Street Stage
Initial D - Street Stage.summary: Initial D: Street Stage is a 2006 game for the PlayStation Portable based on the Initial D series. It is a console port of Initial D Arcade Stage 3.

Monster Hunter Freedom 2.name: Monster Hunter Freedom 2
Monster Hunter Freedom 2.summary: Monster Hunter Freedom 2 is a standalone PSP entry that adapts the core content of Monster Hunter 2 into a new single-player campaign, with additional content created for the handheld release. Players complete hunting, gathering, and treasure quests, using materials obtained from monsters and the environment to craft and upgrade weapons and armor. Quests can be undertaken alone or cooperatively by up to four players through local ad hoc multiplayer.

Saint Seiya Omega - Ultimate Cosmo.name: Saint Seiya Omega: Ultimate Cosmo
Saint Seiya Omega - Ultimate Cosmo.summary: Saint Seiya Omega: Ultimate Cosmo is an Action game, developed and published by Bandai Namco Games, which was released in Japan in 2012.
